nonrecursive_historical_dependencies: Complete manifested C8 lower candidate/review, selected cyclic and prime-power proof/review documents, prior public scope records, and the new candidate embedded sparse dependencies are preserved. Full parent archives and deeper historical dependencies are not recursively republished.
excluded_categories: All native workbook row values, notes, IDs, snapshots, read chunks and private receipts

Full third-party copyrighted paper bodies or images
Credentials, private Library transfer links, unrelated files
